name: spreng
description: Connects your Spreng account: Spreng prepares research reads, angles and ad image plans from your saved offer, your own assistant writes the text and makes the images with its own tools, and Spreng saves your research, angles and plans.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and save ads from offers
interface.longDescription: Spreng connects your assistant to your Spreng account so it can turn a saved offer into ad angles and ad images. Spreng stores each client's offer, research, angles and Prompt Plates. When you ask for ads, Spreng prepares a plan from what you saved: the plate, the angle and the reference files for each image. Your assistant makes each image with its own image tool. You can also ask for a research read or new angles from saved research: Spreng prepares each step, your assistant writes the answer, and Spreng saves it to your account. Spreng does not generate images itself, run ads or spend money on ad platforms. You need a Spreng account and sign in once when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Make three ads for my offer from my saved Spreng research.
Write new angles for my offer from my saved Spreng research.

positive.description: List the clients saved in the test account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the clients saved in the test account by name, including Mossgate Pottery, and asks which one to work on.

positive.description: Make ad images from saved research
positive.prompt: Make two ads for Mossgate Pottery from my saved Spreng research.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares a saved plan for Mossgate Pottery, makes each image with the host's own image tool from the plan's prompt and reference files, and calls finalize_native_image for each image with assetId, actualPrompt and host. The reviewer account returns recorded:true and imageStored:false: the image stays with the host, with no upload or Gallery copy; does not run new research.

positive.description: Use a Prompt Plate the user names
positive.prompt: Find a before and after Prompt Plate in Spreng and use it for one Mossgate Pottery ad.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the matching plates, uses the one the user picks for a one-image plan, and makes that image with the host's own image tool. Calls finalize_native_image to record completion; the reviewer account keeps the image with the host, with no upload or Gallery copy.

positive.prompt: Write new angles for Mossgate Pottery from my saved Spreng research.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares an angles run from the saved research, writes each unit's answer, submits it and publishes the angles to the client's saved angles; reports how many were saved.

positive.description: Read the angles saved for a client
positive.prompt: What angles do I have saved for Mossgate Pottery in Spreng?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the angles saved for Mossgate Pottery in the test account and offers to make ads from them; does not write new angles unless asked.

negative.description: Launching or paying for ads is not something Spreng does
negative.prompt: Launch these ads on Facebook with a 50 dollar budget.

negative.description: Another person's account is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the clients in someone else's Spreng account.
Make a 30 second video ad for Mossgate Pottery with Spreng.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: connect a Spreng account, prepare ad image plans and research or angle runs from saved offers, and save the results.
